internal.title: Incident Summary: Elevated Error Rates in Cart Service
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:18 UTC, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the cart service. Initial diagnosis identified error injection as the primary cause, supported by elevated error rates around 10-12%. Secondary latency issues were noted but not confirmed as root cause. Attempts to mitigate by restarting the checkout service were blocked by guardrails due to missing dry run and target mismatches. The incident was resolved after addressing the error injection in the cart service.

Timeline highlights:
- 12:18: Alert received for cart service error rate spike.
- 12:38: Multiple diagnosis rounds focusing on checkout latency.
- 12:38-12:39: Proposals to restart services were refused by guardrails.
- Resolution achieved by mitigating error injection in cart.

Lessons learned and action items are documented for future prevention and faster resolution.

external.title: Intermittent Issues with Cart Service Resolved
external.body: Between 12:18 and 12:40 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced intermittent errors when using the cart service. Our team identified and resolved the issue related to injected errors affecting the cart functionality. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience as we worked to restore normal service.

output.summary: Elevated error rates in the cart service caused intermittent customer impact, resolved by mitigating error injection.
output.impact: Customers experienced intermittent errors in the cart service, affecting their ability to add or modify items in the cart during the incident window.
output.root_cause: The root cause was an error injection in the cart service, confirmed by elevated error rates and supported by diagnostic evidence. Attempts to mitigate via service restarts were initially blocked by safety guardrails.
output.resolution: The incident was resolved by identifying and mitigating the error injection in the cart service, restoring normal operation.
